reason: Reviewed Diageo's 20-F filing for FY2025 ending June 30, 2025. The filing contains extensive segment revenue data (North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Latin America & Caribbean, Africa) and product category breakdowns (Spirits, Beer, Ready to Drink), but does not disclose any total addressable market (TAM) figures or market size estimates. No TAM data found in business overview, management discussion, or segment reporting sections. The company does not provide market sizing for its beverage alcohol categories.
